mapper.select: /* DailyEntryMapper.selectOpenEntryRequest */ SELECT REQ_ID AS reqId , SITE_CD AS siteCd , USER_CD AS userCd , REQ_TYPE AS reqType , REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus FROM TB_DAILY_ENTRY_REQUEST WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd} AND ( REQ_STATUS = '01' OR ( REQ_STATUS = '02' AND REQ_DTIME >= CURDATE() ) ) ORDER BY REQ_DTIME DESC LIMIT 1

/* DailyEntryMapper.selectEntryRequestMetaForUpdate */ SELECT REQ_ID AS reqId , SITE_CD AS siteCd , USER_CD AS userCd , REQ_TYPE AS reqType , REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus FROM TB_DAILY_ENTRY_REQUEST WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND REQ_ID = #{reqId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: /* DailyEntryMapper.updateExpireOverdueEntryRequests */ UPDATE TB_DAILY_ENTRY_REQUEST SET REQ_STATUS = '04' , UPDATE_NO = #{updateNo} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE REQ_STATUS IN ('01', '02') AND REQ_DTIME < CURDATE()
